u0: At this normal carrying stage, the box is in the agent's hands and no recovery from a fall is pending. The agent still needs to reach the exit while satisfying the box-carrying requirement. If the box slips, the very next step must be used to pick it up again; otherwise the task fails.
u1: The box has just slipped from the agent's hands away from the exit, creating a one-step recovery deadline. The agent must be carrying the box on the immediately following step; recovering it restores normal progress, and doing so at the exit completes the task. If the agent is still empty-handed on that next step, the task fails irreversibly.
u2: The agent has reached the exit without the box in hand, so the task is not yet complete and the carrying requirement remains outstanding. The agent must come to carry the box without another fall; doing so satisfies the pending requirement and completes the task. Remaining empty-handed leaves the requirement unresolved, while a fall adds an immediate next-step pickup obligation.
u3: The task is complete: the exit has been reached and all required box-carrying conditions are satisfied, with no outstanding recovery from a fall. Any prior slip was recovered on the next step, and the box is in hand at completion.
u4: A fall has just occurred while an exit-related carrying obligation was already pending, so the agent faces a one-step recovery deadline. If the box is held on the next step without a new fall, all obligations are met and the task completes. If the agent remains empty-handed or another fall occurs without the box being held, the task fails.
u5: A fall and an unresolved exit-carrying requirement leave the agent at a critical last-chance carrying check. The box must be in hand on the next step with no new fall; if so, all requirements are satisfied and the task completes. If the hands are empty or a fall occurs without the box being held, the task fails.
u6: A mandatory carrying rule has been broken for good: the box was not restored on the step immediately after a fall, or the required box had not been secured when an urgent carrying check was due. Successful completion is no longer possible.
